meta.name: constraint-specification
meta.description: Defining output format, length, tone, and content boundaries within prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义输出格式、长度、语气和内容边界
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要精确控制AI输出的格式和风格
copy.tagline_en: Define output format, length, tone, and content boundaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need precise control over AI output format and style

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会根据你指定的格式、长度、语气、内容和质量标准来生成回答，确保输出符合你的精确要求。
howto.when: 当你在提示中明确要求输出格式（如JSON、列表）、字数范围、语气风格、内容包含/排除项等约束时触发。

say.text: 用JSON格式回答，包含name和price字段，不超过150字。
say.note: Claude会生成指定JSON结构且控制长度。

say.text: 用正式语气写一段产品介绍，禁止使用“绝佳”这类夸张词汇。
say.note: Claude会调整语气并避免禁词。

say.text: 你的回答中60%是分析，40%是建议，总字数200-300。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude follows your constraints on format, length, tone, content, and quality—producing outputs that meet your exact specifications.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you specify output format (e.g., JSON, bullets), length range, tone style, content include/exclude, or other constraints in your prompt.

say_en.text: Respond in JSON with name and price fields, under 150 words.
say_en.note: Claude outputs structured JSON with length control.

say_en.text: Write a product description in formal tone, avoid exaggerated words like 'amazing'.
say_en.note: Claude adjusts tone and excludes forbidden terms.

say_en.text: Allocate 60% to analysis and 40% to recommendations, total 200-300 words.
say_en.note: Claude follows the proportion and word count.
